=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11073-11104 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: maybe_auto_resume_final_merge_exhausted does not check whether `set_tracking_phase_label "ai:validated"` or the `ai:needs-human` removal actually succeeded before it calls mark_validation_complete. Its fallback also adds ai:validated to the in-memory TRACKING_LABELS and drops ai:blocked, even when the issue does not carry those changes.
  WHY: A label API failure can still let the merge run, or let the readiness check `has_label "${TRACKING_LABELS:-[]}" "ai:validated"` at line 14214 pass, while the issue still carries ai:blocked / ai:needs-human. Local state and issue labels then disagree, and the project can be stranded or diverted to the validating fallback at 28166-28175. Severity is disputed: google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite and minimax_minimax-m3 say MAJOR, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and openai_gpt-6-luna say NIT; this ledger uses the highest.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10945-10957 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The comprehensive-cycle skip logs `reason=not_final_merge_exhausted detail=comprehensive_cycle`, but the project did fail by final-merge exhaustion.
  WHY: Monitoring or alerting that keys on the stable FINAL_MERGE_AUTO_RESUME reason token will misclassify real exhaustion parks of comprehensive cycles, and the reuse conflicts with the reason enum in the agents.d registry.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11003-11056 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When `final_merge_auto_resumed_head_shas` exists but is not an array, the already-resumed lookup treats it as "not resumed", and the guard write then replaces it with `[$sha]`.
  WHY: This contradicts the fail-closed contract (header comment at line 10905, and the issue's "skip the retry" on unexpected shapes): earlier retried heads are discarded and a head can be retried twice. It is reachable only through malformed state.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~11056 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The per-head guard slices the retry history to the last 20 entries (`| .[-20:]`), so after 20 distinct retried heads the oldest SHA drops out and can qualify for another automatic retry.
  WHY: A project that cycles through 20+ distinct PR heads can retry an already-retried head again, which defeats the issue's "Stop after one try per head SHA" guard.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11064-11068 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The rollback restore `mv "${STATE_FILE}.famr_bak" "${STATE_FILE}" 2>/dev/null || true` hides its own failure.
  WHY: If the restore fails (disk full, permission, cross-device), STATE_FILE keeps the unpublished `validating` state and the only log line is the generic warning or "Project already failed, skipping.", so operators never see the failed restore. minimax_minimax-m3 says the project gets stuck; z-ai_glm-5_3-flash says the damage is tick-local.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11057-11067 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The new ".famr_bak" rollback path has no test coverage.
  WHY: A future regression that breaks the backup restore or cleanup could leave state inconsistent without CI noticing.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:28173-28414 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: No test simulates a post_state_comment failure after the jq write, so the .famr_bak rollback path is untested.
  WHY: A regression that reorders the writes, drops the restore mv, or breaks the .famr_bak cleanup would not be caught, and projects could be left half-transitioned with no CI signal.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10910-11106 | severity=high | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The resume path's core deliverable (resume → `final_merge_status=merged`) has no confirmed green CI run. `orchestrate-poll (2)` failed on head 208bf05, the pre-push gate marks the test file "Unverified: timeout", and the only local run of the two resume tests (tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:28236-28353) failed in a degraded sandbox.
  WHY: If the sandbox attribution is wrong, the single retry per head is spent without a merge attempt and the feature silently never merges. No code defect is demonstrated.
- tests/test_alert_levels_human_only.py:test_cycle_summary_counts_projects_and_prints_project_timing | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The failing `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` check-run is caused by a negative `elapsed_ms` (-747) that SUMMARY_RE rejects. No PR hunk touches the cycle-summary helpers.
  WHY: It currently turns the aggregate `lint` job red and should be triaged as an environment or clock flake, not silently block the merge. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 makes the same observation in its pass-1 notes.
- tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py; tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py; tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py; tests/test_session_start_extract_repo_slug.py; tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py; shellcheck:pre-push gate list | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The pre-push gate classifies these six as "caused by this change", but no PR hunk touches the guarded surfaces, the static-checks job passed on the same head, and the shellcheck failure carries no file:line.
  WHY: Either the gate's caused-by classification is wrong or an environment difference triggers these tests; until that is resolved the gate stays red for a reason the diff may not own.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "retry through the existing final-merge path (`finalize_integration_merge_if_needed` / `mark_validation_complete`), so every current gate still applies, including the security pass and the comprehensive promotion gate"
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, maybe_auto_resume_final_merge_exhausted (comprehensive-cycle skip at lines 10951-10959)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Every project with `.comprehensive_release_callback.handled == true` is skipped before the resume attempt, so those projects never resume and the comprehensive promotion gate is never exercised for them. The linked issue neither defers this nor lists it as out of scope; its out-of-scope list is only MAX_FINAL_MERGE_ATTEMPTS, the ai:force-merge bypass and budget-ineligible deferrals. README, changelog and the agents.d fragment document the exclusion anyway. Several reviewers note that failing closed is defensible, because handle_comprehensive_release_callback_if_needed at line 17176 already removed ai:comprehensive-test-pending. Severity is disputed: MAJOR from gemini, minimax and luna; NIT from sonnet and glm.
- requirement: "Reuse the PR and check-run data the terminal block and `_summarize_final_merge_blockers` already fetch. ... This adds at most one PR read and one check-run read per such project per tick, and nothing for any other project."
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, maybe_auto_resume_final_merge_exhausted (and its terminal-block caller)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The function makes fresh calls to `_fetch_pr_json` (10985), `_pr_checks_completed` (11023) and `compute_cycle_integration_ahead_by` (11031), three remote reads per qualifying project per tick, and reuses none of the `_summarize_final_merge_blockers` data. The agents.d fragment registers the third call itself. minimax_minimax-m3 notes that the terminal block does not prefetch PR or check-run data for failed projects. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 declined to report this, saying the compare call is the check the issue requires and that there was no earlier fetch to reuse. Severity is disputed: MAJOR from gemini and minimax, NIT from glm.
- requirement: "Record each final-PR head SHA that has had an automatic retry" / "Stop after one try per head SHA."
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, maybe_auto_resume_final_merge_exhausted (guard write at line 11056)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Line 11056 truncates `final_merge_auto_resumed_head_shas` to `.[-20:]`. After 20 distinct retried heads an older SHA is dropped, and if the PR returns to that head the once-per-head check at ~11003-11004 lets it retry again. The agents.d fragment and changelog document the 20-entry cap, but the issue does not. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash notes that the head-must-equal-`validation_last_passed_sha` gate bounds the practical impact, and anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 declined to report it. Severity is disputed: MAJOR from gemini, minimax and luna; NIT from glm.
- requirement: Pass the pre-push test gate.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_files_touched_scope_guard.py
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: test_files_touched_scope_guard.py fails on the current PR head (BLOCKER). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disputes this: the test only calls guard.evaluate / evaluate_allowlist on hard-coded path lists and reads nothing this PR changes. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash says the gate's "caused by" classification cannot be mapped to the diff.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:lines 11084-11087, the else branch of maybe_auto_resume_final_merge_exhausted: TRACKING_LABELS="$(... 'map(select(. != "ai:blocked" and ($keep_nh == "true" or . != "ai:needs-human"))) + ["ai:validated"] | unique' ...)" | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The fallback keeps ai:needs-human when its removal failed, but it still adds ai:validated and drops ai:blocked unconditionally. This branch runs exactly when the fresh read at 11081-11082 shows no ai:validated.
  WHY: `has_label "${TRACKING_LABELS:-[]}" "ai:validated"` at line 14214 passes on a label the issue does not carry. If the retry defers, the next tick lands in the validating fallback at 28166-28175 instead of the ai:validated path at 28157. Suggested fix: add ai:validated and drop ai:blocked only when the label write succeeded; otherwise skip the merge this tick.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:line 10957, echo "${log_prefix} outcome=skip reason=not_final_merge_exhausted detail=comprehensive_cycle" | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The comprehensive-cycle skip reuses reason=not_final_merge_exhausted even though the marker check at 10947 has just passed.
  WHY: Counters and alerts on the stable FINAL_MERGE_AUTO_RESUME reason will file real exhaustion parks as "not eligible"; only the optional detail field tells them apart.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:line 11056, (if (.final_merge_auto_resumed_head_shas | type) == "array" then .final_merge_auto_resumed_head_shas else [] end), plus the earlier guard check | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A once-per-head history that is present but not an array is treated as "not resumed" and replaced with [$sha].
  WHY: This violates the issue's fail-closed rule and discards earlier retried heads. Suggested fix: skip with reason=lookup_failed detail=state.
